_comment: v0.1.0 'cart' pump (op_cart.py, cart_gen.py, cart_check.py, V010-CART.md): Accu-Chek Insight-type 1.6 ml cartridge + original Insight Adapter & Tubing, NFP-608-26.45 + spur pair + translating M2 piston rod, cup-pod main board unchanged. TEST ONLY, WATER ONLY. Every cartridge / adapter number is an ESTIMATE until measured on a sample (docs/insight-research.md: no drawings are public).

cartridge.part: Accu-Chek Insight-class 1.6 ml glass cartridge: NovoRapid PumpCart format (type 1 glass, bromobutyl stopper, bromobutyl/polyisoprene septum, SmPC 6.5 VERIFIED); bench sample = EMPTY mylife YpsoPump Reservoir 1.6 ml (PZN 11160770, same cartridge class, fit with the Insight adapter UNVERIFIED). WATER ONLY.
cartridge.status: ALL dimensions ESTIMATE (Penfill-class glass: OD 11.6 / ID 9.7 assumed); MEASURE on the sample, then regenerate

adapter.part: original Accu-Chek Insight Adapter & Tubing 40 cm (REF 06485472001, PZN 08460327, 10 per box): adapter with central needle, bayonet nose, vent (>= 0.65 bar), tubing integrated. Unmodified apart from the clip-on lock flag.
adapter.status: ALL geometry ESTIMATE (manual: nose enters the housing notches, turns clockwise to a stop, flush with the housing); MEASURE

receiver._comment: bayonet socket for the adapter nose in a lane-1 collar; entry channels at entry_deg / +180, lock at lock_deg / +180 (manual: about 90 deg clockwise to the stop); the lug groove is cut only in a +-sector_deg band around +-Y so it does not set the height

gears.part: brass spur gears module 0.3: pinion z12 bore 2.0 (on the NFP D-shaft, Loctite 648; root d 2.85, rim 0.42), gear z40 (tip d 12.6) with a hex pocket for the M2 nut (drill + file or print-and-bond), CANDIDATE listings in BUY-LIST section 7

rod.part: DIN 975 threaded rod M2 x 0.4, brass or zinc-plated steel (GHW), cut to rod_len; never wet (behind the stopper)

nut.part: DIN 934 M2 brass, AF 4.0, h 1.6, bonded in the gear hex pocket

slider.part: printed anti-rotation slider bonded on the rod rear end, runs in the U channel of the tub

pusher.part: printed / turned pusher disc on the rod front end, flat face on the stopper

magnet.note: diametric d2 x 1 (BUY-LIST A4) bonded on the pinion front face / shaft end

board.part: cup-pod main board UNCHANGED (electronics/v010/cup, 6 layers, 35.6 x 12.6 x 0.8, top parts <= 1.45, bottom parts over the cell)

lock._comment: adapter-locked sensing: the board's dock hall input (DRV5032) on a short flex at the front wall reads a d1 x 0.5 magnet on a clip-on flag of the adapter; it drives the existing DOCKED gate (forward only when locked, reverse only when unlocked)

targets._comment: smaller than the Accu-Chek Insight (84 x 52 x 19 with adapter, user manual Appendix A VERIFIED) in every axis
